info.title: Pin Inspector Web Pro 2.0 API
info.description:
Comprehensive REST API specification for Pin Inspector Web Pro 2.0 - Reverse-Engineered Pinterest Desktop Application Intelligence Suite.

Covers all backend endpoints for keywords generation, pins analysis, boards extraction, creator profiling, annotations mining, trend intelligence, and rank tracking.

tags.name: Session & System
tags.description: Pinterest session cookie management, connection health, and CORS media proxying

tags.name: Keywords Generator
tags.description: A-Z keyword suggestions, alphabet tree mining, and Keywords Everywhere search volume enrichment

tags.name: Pins Analyzer
tags.description: Live search, category extraction, single pin scraping, and high-concurrency batch metadata scraping

tags.name: Top Pins
tags.description: Discover and analyze the top popular reference Pins (Top 9 Pins) from Pinterest Trends with resolved numeric Pin IDs, visual hashes, and repin engagement

tags.name: Boards Analyzer
tags.description: Pinterest board discovery, follower metrics, section inspection, and board-pin bulk extraction

tags.name: People / Accounts
tags.description: Creator account search, profile intelligence, user-board extraction, and user pins scraping

tags.name: Pin Annotations
tags.description: Guided search annotation tags discovery, reverse annotation mining from pins/keywords, and database management

tags.name: Pinterest Trends
tags.description: Official Pinterest trends discovery, 52-week historical curves, latest trending topics, and top 9 pins per trend

tags.name: Position Tracker
tags.description: Pin rank tracking and SERP position monitoring across keywords, guided annotations, and countries

get.description: HTML user interface rendering the interactive Swagger / OpenAPI API documentation.

get.description: Returns the complete machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 specification for Pin Inspector Web Pro 2.0.
Checks the active Pinterest session, CSRF token status, cookie length, and custom cookie status.

get.description: Bypasses browser CORS restrictions by streaming the requested Pinterest image with attachment download headers.
Queries Pinterest autocomplete typeahead API using recursive alphabet and digit exploration (a-z, 0-9).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Seed keyword(s), comma-separated for bulk seeds

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Keyword generation mode: after (seed + a-z0-9), before (a-z0-9 + seed), both (combinations), single (seed alone), or aa_zz (two-letter combos)

200.description: List of discovered keyword suggestions with rank and word counts

post.summary: Enrich Keywords with Search Volume (Keywords Everywhere)
post.description: Fetches monthly search volume, cost per click (CPC), and competition index for a list of keywords.

200.description: Keyword metrics enrichment data keyed by lowercase keyword

get.description: Searches Pinterest pins by keyword query with support for pagination bookmarks and Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Target number of pins to retrieve

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Set to true to stream pins progressively via Server-Sent Events

parameters.name: aiFilter
parameters.description: Filter pins by Artificial Intelligence status: 'all' (default), 'ai-only' (only AI-generated / AI-modified pins), or 'human-only' (only authentic human/organic pins)

get.description: Fetches top pins for specific official Pinterest categories.
Scrapes extended real-time data for a single pin ID, including comments count, repin count, dominant colors, and creator bio.

parameters.name: pinId
parameters.description: Pinterest numeric pin ID or full URL

post.description: Concurrently scrapes detailed metadata for an array of pin IDs or URLs with controlled parallelism.

200.description: Batch scraped pin details and lookup map

get.description: Searches public Pinterest boards matching a keyword query, returning follower counts, pin counts, and cover images.

get.summary: Extract All Pins from a Board
get.description: Fetches all individual pins contained inside a specific board ID.

parameters.name: deep
parameters.description: Set to true to enrich each pin with 56-column metadata

get.description: Finds Pinterest user profiles matching a search query, including follower counts, verified status, and bios.
Extracts pins published or curated by a specific username.

post.summary: Bulk Scrape Pins for Multiple Users
post.description: Fetches pins across multiple creators in a single batch operation.

get.summary: Get Public Boards of a User
get.description: Lists all public boards created by a specific user handle.
Fetches Pinterest official guided search annotation tags for a query.

post.description: Reverse-engineers annotation tags and dominant themes from a list of pin links/IDs or pin objects.
Extracts guided search annotation pills for a list of seed keywords.

Expands seed keywords into related search interests using Pinterest's InterestResource (seo_related_interests). Supports input as an array of keyword strings (e.g. ['home decor']), an array of annotation objects, or a single term string.

items.description: Array of keyword strings or annotation objects with category links

keywords.description: Direct list of keyword strings to expand

Redirects to /api/trends/generate if phrase, seed, or query is provided, or /api/trends/latest otherwise.
Generates trend curves, normalized interest volume, and related trending concepts for a seed term.
Retrieves the official top trending keywords and rising topics on Pinterest for the given country.

post.description: Looks up Pinterest trends historical metrics for a custom list of keywords.

get.summary: Get Top Pins (Popular 9 Pins for Keyword)
get.description: Direct alias for retrieving the top 9 popular reference Pins (Top Pins) for any search keyword or trending phrase, including resolved numeric Pin IDs, repin counts, and saves.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: Keyword term or phrase to extract top pins for (e.g. 'ikea hacks', 'home decor')

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter country code (e.g. US, GB, CA)

200.description: Top Pins list with resolved Pin IDs and engagement metrics

get.summary: Get Top 9 Pins for Trending Term
get.description: Retrieves the exact 9 popular reference pins (Top Pins) directly from the Pinterest Trends term_images service with resolved visual hashes and numeric Pin IDs.
Retrieves the complete weekly historical trend curve coordinates (52 data points) for a keyword.

200.description: 52-week historical trend curve data and 12-month timeline

get.summary: Detect AI-Modified or AI-Generated Status for a Pin
get.description: Inspects a Pinterest Pin to determine whether it is AI-generated (Midjourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion) or AI-modified (e.g. Photoshop GenAI fill) using Pinterest IPTC digital_media_source_type platform flags, creator hashtag disclosures (#aiart), and visual AI annotations.

parameters.name: pinId
parameters.description: Pinterest numeric Pin ID or full Pin URL

isAiModified.description: Whether the pin is AI-modified or AI-generated
Whether the pin is AI-modified or AI-generated

aiType.description: Specific classification: AI Generated, AI Modified, AI Disclosed, AI Annotated, or NO

seo_related_interests.description: Raw Pinterest SEO interest objects associated with this term

ideas_klp_pivots.description: Raw Pinterest KLP idea pivot objects associated with this term
